nodes.description: Public address state variable `owner`, initialized to msg.sender at deployment; used as the access-control anchor in the `restricted` modifier.
Public uint state variable tracking the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) restricted that writes the `completed` argument into last_completed_migration.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used both to initialize `owner` and in the require check inside the restricted modifier.
Parameter `completed` of setCompleted, supplied by the caller and written directly to storage.
State write `last_completed_migration = completed` executed inside setCompleted after the restricted guard.
Modifier restricted containing require(msg.sender == owner), an access-control guard applied to setCompleted.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable at declaration time, defining who holds privileged rights.
The untrusted msg.sender determines whether the require(msg.sender == owner) check inside the restricted modifier passes.
The owner state variable is read and compared against msg.sender in the restricted modifier's require statement.
The restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted, only allowing the owner to proceed.
The caller-supplied parameter `completed` flows directly into the state-write operation.
The unsafe operation writes the supplied value into the last_completed_migration state variable.
setCompleted is the function body that performs the state write represented by the unsafe operation.
setCompleted reads and updates the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core parameter `completed` has no independent semantic identity; it exists only to supply the value written by the unsafe_operation `last_completed_migration = completed`, so it is merged into node 5.
